subject: Integrate memory and task context compiler
description: Integrate the new retrieval modules into a first-class context compiler. Scope: add lib/search/memory-search.js and lib/search/context-compiler.js if useful, wire routes/graph.js to delegate to the new modules while preserving backward-compatible /search behavior, and add MCP tool surfaces only if the codebase pattern makes that low-risk. No broad rewrite. Task-key search must use pinned task context first; no-task search must use weighted activation after RAG/entity seeds. Preserve existing temporal, system-note, gated, confidence, rerank, and recall-journal semantics or document any intentionally deferred gaps in tests/comments. Depends on activation and task-context module tasks.
